about: Two observers of one world hold their own origins, and their verdicts differ on the cells where one has looked and the other has not.
That is not a contradiction: wherever they hold the same origins at a cell they agree, every time.
What a cell is depends on who is reading, and the disagreement is the difference of their horizons, never of the world.

cases.name: a shared core of a hundred cells and two private sets of origins
